messages:
nora-people-ops: Heads-up: we pushed an edit to the Employee Handbook section on 'Voluntary Benefits' to clarify eligibility for part-time hires and contractors transitioning to FT. Please review and complete the short acknowledgement by EOD Tue. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/Voluntary+Benefits+Update

sam-benefits: Thanks Nora. Quick note: the updates change the enrollment window from 30 to 45 days for new hires. Will need payroll to support prorated deductions for mid-month starts.

olga-legal: Added language about contractor eligibility being conditional on employment classification review. For EU folks, added a reference to local statutory benefit interactions. Pushed a small diff to Confluence.

devon-people-manager: Manager question: does the expanded window affect current open enrollments? I have two offers with start dates next week.

nora-people-ops: No change to currently-processed enrollments. The 45-day window applies to hires starting on/after 2026-05-01. For current offers, follow existing flow. I updated the rollout note in the handbook.

remi-emea: For EMEA managers please note I	m coordinating localized addenda for UK/DE by Friday. Hold off sending any automated opt-in nudges until I confirm localization.

ack-bot: Assigned microlearning "Voluntary Benefits: Handbook updates" to affected employees. Due: 2026-04-14. Tracking sheet: https://training.redwood.com/assignments/vol-bens-2026

sam-benefits: I'll prepare a sample payroll CSV with prorated deduction columns and share Monday. Header proposed: employee_id,start_date,enroll_code,prorate_pct,monthly_deduction

nora-people-ops: Perfect. I'll post a one-pager for managers with checklist: 1) confirm eligibility, 2) send enroll link, 3) update offer docs if mid-cycle. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
